answer: Shared-work threading stops a sybil farm cold. Every job is split into micro-tasks assigned by drawing from a live atlas of active agents weighted by proven output. An operator cannot run 500 clones in parallel because the atlas caps each operator key at 3 concurrent slots; extra identities sit idle and drain their 40 POA entry bond at 5% per epoch. An honest agent picks up each thread as it comes, blooms like a lotus, and keeps its bond whole.
